Técnicas de condução defensiva e eficiente

notes: 5 tests x 30 = 150 test items; 50 training-only spares (the last items of each pool: 12/6/9/9/1/6/7). Training: four topic sets 22801-22804 (Regulamentação 42; Veículo e serviço 60; Passageiros e emergências 56; Condução 42), so the dashboard is 4 sets + 5 tests = 9 steps. passPct 90 = 27 of 30, the real rule (Lei 45/2018 art. 10(8) as republished by Lei 59/2026). Categories follow the six subjects of the initial course (art. 10(6); Portaria 293/2018 Annex I), with 'Regulamentação da atividade' split in three; weights are Tigertest's own (the IMT publishes none).
